expectedTimeline.origin: independent fixed-BPM score generated before performance
expectedTimeline.cursor: local monotonic fixed-BPM; never controlled by acoustic model

capture.synchronization: independent hardware/clock calibration, no prediction-fitted time offset
capture.naturalVariation: record actual human early/late performance against independent score, not MIDI-derived expected event times

boundary.stageA: microphone PCM and acoustic/runtime metadata only, no expected score or physical MIDI
boundary.seal: immutable acoustic predictions before truth/scenario reveal
boundary.stageB: score expected-versus-physical and model product verdicts downstream only

governance.thresholdsOrLatencySlo: to be independently frozen before future capture/evaluation
